name: SCENTAI Catalog Selection Policy
purpose: Select high-demand, high-quality, commercially useful fragrances without relying on a single retailer or community.
principles: Do not rank products by affiliate commission.
Do not treat a high community rating with a tiny vote count as equivalent to a proven bestseller.
Use multiple independent demand signals when available.
Keep women's and feminine-leaning unisex coverage as an explicit portfolio objective.
Prefer products that improve recommendation coverage, price comparison, or original-vs-alternative clusters.
Never invent sales counts when retailers only expose bestseller ordering or labels.

retailer_demand.description: Bestseller/ranking evidence from German fragrance retailers. Exact unit sales are used only when a source publishes them.
retailer_demand.method: Normalize rank/placement per retailer; combine multiple retailers; do not fabricate sales volumes.

community_strength.description: Combine rating quality and confidence from the number of community ratings/reviews.
community_strength.method: Use a Bayesian/confidence-adjusted rating so 9.0 from 50 votes cannot outrank 8.4 from thousands solely on raw score.

cross_merchant_coverage.description: Reward products available from multiple approved merchants because they enable genuine price comparison.
cross_merchant_coverage.method: Count verified merchant offers/feeds; cap the contribution so availability never dominates recommendation quality.

trend_momentum.description: Current awards, recent bestseller movement, new-release attention, and repeated SCENTAI search demand.

portfolio_fit.description: Fill gaps in audience, season, occasion, price tier, scent family, and original/alternative clusters.
guardrails: Women's and feminine-leaning unisex coverage must increase materially from the current baseline.
Do not let the catalog become only designer bestsellers or only dupes.
Maintain fresh, gourmand, floral, woody, amber/oriental, musky and aquatic coverage.

minimum_evidence_before_live.identity: Exact brand, fragrance name and concentration verified.
minimum_evidence_before_live.demand: At least two independent demand/community signals, or one very strong retailer signal plus verified catalog-gap rationale.
minimum_evidence_before_live.community: If community rating is used, record rating and vote/review count together.
minimum_evidence_before_live.commerce: Merchant availability may be absent at candidate stage but must never be invented.
minimum_evidence_before_live.relationships: Clone/inspired/alternative labels require separate evidence review.

audience_policy.note: Feminine/masculine leaning is an editorial scent-style descriptor, not an absolute statement about who can wear a fragrance.

promotion_rules.score_65_79: Good candidate; promote when it fills a catalog gap or has strong merchant coverage.
promotion_rules.score_50_64: Keep in backlog; needs stronger evidence or clearer portfolio role.
